The full test suite is green — **59 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, BUILD SUCCESS**.

## Summary

The business-day rule for the registration date already skipped weekends but not public holidays. I extended it in the single source of that logic:

**`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/DefaultRegistrationDate.java`**
- Added the fixed public-holiday set (2026-01-01, 2026-01-26, 2026-04-25, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28).
- Updated `toBusinessDay(...)` so the roll-forward loop also skips any date in that holiday set — so a date landing on a holiday advances to the next non-holiday weekday (and if that next day is itself a weekend/holiday, e.g. 2026-12-25 → 26th/27th weekend → 28th holiday → 29th, it keeps rolling).
- Updated the class Javadoc to describe the holiday behaviour.

This matches the reference `toBusinessDay`/`HOLIDAYS` table the tests pin in `AcceptanceBase`, and `Cp47Tests` (the new holiday-business-day acceptance test) passes along with all existing tests.
